'''Bol''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Mantellian Separatist]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] during the Ord Mantell [[Separatist War|civil war]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], which was backing the [[Ord Mantell Central Authority|Mantellian Government]]. He was stationed in the [[Separatist Base]] on [[Mannett Point]] when a [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|promising Republic trooper]] [[Mission to Mannett Point (Havoc Squad)|infiltrated]] the base. He and two of [[Saphrro|his]] [[Vyru|fellow]] officers attempted to resist the trooper but were killed in the process.
